---
title: Add Notifications
description: >-
  Draft and send push notifications by writing engaging custom titles and
  messages, choosing specific target audience tags, and selecting immediate or
  scheduled delivery times.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Notification > Add Notification.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="262" height="162" style="width: 262px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Enter notification title and content.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="505" height="304" style="width: 505px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Select related post and segments. Pick the start and end dates.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="347" height="310" style="width: 347px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="265" height="191" style="width: 265px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
